title: Sir Oliver's Shining Courtyard
moral: Being kind and working together makes everything better.

scenes.summary: Sir Oliver sees the messy courtyard and decides to clean it.
scenes.text: Sir Oliver lived in a bright kingdom. One morning, he saw the courtyard full of leaves and twigs. He decided to clean it so it would shine for everyone.
scenes.image_prompt: little knight looking at messy courtyard with leaves and broom colorful cartoon style
scenes.story: Sir Oliver was a little knight who lived in a bright kingdom. One day, he saw the courtyard was messy with leaves and twigs. He decided to clean it. His dog Daisy helped him. They worked together but found a big pile of sticks blocking the path. Carefully, they removed the sticks. When more leaves blew in, Sir Oliver did not give up. He asked his friend Mia to help. Together they cleaned and even helped a small mouse safely. By the end, the courtyard was shining. The king and queen praised them. Sir Oliver felt proud and happy, knowing kindness and teamwork made the task easier.
